study.question: Does the row-specific auxiliary label-deviation cotangent recover the sign-sensitive click effect lost when its bit source is replaced by occupied-task-mean BCE, at the inherited fixed-angle shared-context transfer?
study.hypothesis: At fixed recipient probabilities/Jacobian, auxiliary cotangents decompose as g_true=g_mean+g_deviation, with g_deviation=VJP(L_aux(true)-L_aux(occupied mean)). The latest task-mean replacement almost eliminated the external-sign AUC gap. If label deviations supply consequential orientation information, a bit extracted from g_deviation should recover a larger reversed-minus-aligned AUC gap than a bit extracted from g_mean, potentially moving toward the native gap. This concerns a conditional source for one training-only sign bit, not all utility of auxiliary labels or a new forward architecture. The source VJP decomposition is linear before the nonlinear geometry; the bit, trajectory and AUC are not additive.

nearest_work.difference: Archived primary paper lines239-303 were inspected: target-dependent unnormalized local activation and BCE are inherited concepts. This experiment adds no new DIN forward structure; it isolates a training-only label-source term for a previously implemented row-space surrogate VJP. No originality claim.

Pinned benchmark forward lines123-170 were read: task-specific history-mask hubs, joint token interaction and task readouts. We retain the local product-context architecture instead and alter only training gradient source. Benchmark code is primary implementation evidence, not verification of the original INFNet paper or novelty.

study.proposed_difference: Add source_component metadata (mean or label_deviation). Every arm computes the same true auxiliary BCE scalar and occupied-mean auxiliary BCE scalar on the same probability graph, then executes one extra autograd.grad with source_loss=0*L_true+1*L_mean for controls or 1*L_true-1*L_mean for candidates. Gradients stop at the three true auxiliary product-context collection outputs. Detached cotangents enter only extra identity edges and determine the bit; native true cotangents still determine radius/line/support. Cross source component with aligned/reversed external sign. New assignment enum is an alias for the inherited bit branch; prediction forward and model parameters are unchanged.
predictions: At the same frozen model state and batch, all four cells have identical probabilities, true joint scalar loss, Dice updates and private parameter gradients. Mean-cell source cotangents and transfer must match the r0067 mean controls within declared numerical tolerances.

The label-deviation VJP agrees with separately probed g_true-g_mean; a uniform-label occupied batch produces a zero source cotangent up to arithmetic tolerance. Native support, line and radius are equal for all source components at fixed state.

Primary mechanistic contrast: Delta_deviation=AUC(deviation,reversed)-AUC(deviation,aligned) exceeds Delta_mean=AUC(mean,reversed)-AUC(mean,aligned). Historical Delta_mean=0.0000134454480478 and native Delta_true=0.0005850163960756 are descriptive anchors, not statistical thresholds.

Recovery of a native-like sign effect by deviation while mean controls replay would provisionally localize the source dependence to label deviations conditional on inherited true-label geometry. Matching mean and native at fixed state with no bit disagreement would instead make the intervention non-discriminating.

Inference parameter count/path should be unchanged; any efficiency statement requires host-measured train/GPU/wall seconds, peak memory and inference throughput/latency. Extra true-source traversal may increase training cost relative to r0067.
falsifiers: If mean controls fail same-sign r0067 replay beyond documented numerical variation, stop attribution and diagnose the changed graph or protocol before interpreting candidate AUC.

If residual VJP fails g_true-g_mean, private gradients/forward state differ, source labels enter inference, or native radius/support changes at fixed state, the implementation does not isolate the intended mechanism.

If source bits differ on active batches but Delta_deviation remains no larger than Delta_mean or favors the opposite sign on paired repeats, the hypothesis that the isolated label-deviation source recovers the native sign effect is not supported.
If deviation cannot distinguish true from mean because bits do not differ, or all transfers are degenerate, the test is ineffective; a null AUC does not prove auxiliary labels unnecessary.
One favorable cell without the sign interaction, effective-bit diagnostics and seed replication cannot establish the claimed mechanism or general auxiliary-supervision benefit.
alternative_explanations: Single frozen seed, many adaptively inspected validation trials and shared users; paired same-seed replays are not independent repetitions.
The recipient Jacobian, batch prevalence, learned private state, native transfer radius and support retain label/prediction information in all arms.
Q pivot extraction is nonlinear and discontinuous; source component magnitudes need not match, and low-margin pivots can turn FP32/BF16 rounding into bit changes.
Row-space orthogonality occurs before repeated-ID sparse accumulation and does not imply parameter-space or optimizer-update orthogonality.

Mean replacement removes label variance as well as row-label association; a deviation-source recovery does not prove semantic information rather than heterogeneous gradient noise is useful. A later permutation of the label-deviation source would be needed to separate those mechanisms.
AUC gaps may reflect optimizer dynamics, global dense clipping, numerical summation or validation selection rather than better generalizable auxiliary information.
